# Code of conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make DockerScope welcoming, safe and equitable for everyone, regardless
of identity, background, disability, experience or personal characteristics.
Every person participating in good faith deserves respect and dignity.

## Community expectations

Be kind and honest, respect different viewpoints and personal boundaries, give and
accept constructive feedback, credit sources, and take responsibility for harm.
Welcome newcomers and communicate patiently across language and cultural differences.

Harassment, personal attacks, stereotyping, discrimination, unwanted sexual attention,
threats, impersonation, doxxing, disclosure of private information and repeated
unwanted promotion are unacceptable. Do not encourage these behaviors in others.

## Reporting and enforcement

For a report that can safely be public, open an issue addressed to @tristanjcb with
only the minimum information necessary; never publish personal details or evidence
that would put someone at risk. For confidential reports involving GitHub activity,
use [GitHub's abuse reporting channel](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse).
That channel is handled by GitHub, not a private maintainer inbox. A separate private
community reporting address will be published when one is available.

The maintainer, @tristanjcb, moderates project spaces, considers context and impact,
and seeks to repair harm while protecting affected people. Possible responses are:

1. A private warning, clarification of expectations and a request to repair harm.
2. A temporary restriction on specific activities after repetition or a serious incident.
3. Temporary suspension with clear conditions for return.
4. Permanent exclusion for severe harm or a persistent pattern of violations.

Steps may be skipped when necessary to protect people. Enforcement should be
proportionate, evidence-based, and as confidential as the reporting channel allows.
A person involved in an incident should not decide the outcome of their own report;
GitHub abuse support is the escalation route where the sole maintainer is involved.

## Scope and attribution

This policy applies in all project spaces and whenever someone officially represents
DockerScope, including issues, reviews, discussions and community events.
